name: Adaptability
description: Increases the STAB (Same Type Attack Bonus) multiplier from 1.5x to 2.0x.

name: Anger Point
description: Maxes Attack stat if hit by a critical hit.

name: Arena Trap
description: Prevents grounded opponents from fleeing.

name: Battle Armor
description: Protects the organism from critical hits.

name: Berserk
description: Boosts Attack when HP falls below 50% due to an attack.

name: Clear Body
description: Prevents other organisms from lowering its stats.

name: Color Change
description: Changes the organism's type to the type of the move it was hit by.

name: Defiant
description: Boosts Attack by two stages when a stat is lowered.

name: Dauntless Shield
description: Boosts Defense when entering battle.

name: Drizzle
description: Summons rain when entering battle.

name: Early Bird
description: Awakens from sleep twice as fast.

name: Poison Touch
description: May poison a target when using a contact move.

name: Poison Point
description: May poison a target on contact.

name: Poison Skin
description: May poison a target on contact.

name: Fur Coat
description: Doubles the organism's Defense stat.

name: Gale Wings
description: Gives priority to Flying-type moves at full HP.

name: Guts
description: Boosts Attack by 50% when having a status condition.

name: Intimidate
description: Lowers opponent's Attack when entering.

name: Limber
description: Protects the organism from paralysis.

name: Immunity
description: Protects the organism from poison.

name: Static
description: May paralyze a target on contact.

name: Flame Body
description: May burn a target on contact.

name: Spiky Body
description: May cause bleeding on contact.

name: Comatose
description: The organism is always asleep and cannot be inflicted with other status conditions.

name: Competitive
description: Boosts Special Attack by two stages when a stat is lowered.

name: Earth Eater
description: Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.

name: Gooey
description: Lowers the speed of the attacker on contact.

name: Gorilla Tactics
description: Boosts Attack but only allows the use of the first selected move.

name: Guard Dog
description: Prevents the effect of Intimidate and forced switching.

name: Heatproof
description: Halves the damage taken from Fire-type moves.

name: Huge Power
description: Doubles the Attack stat.

name: Hustle
description: Boosts Attack by 50% but lowers accuracy.

name: Hydration
description: Cures status conditions at the end of the turn if it is raining.

name: Mimic
description: Disguises itself as the last animal in the party.

name: Insomnia
description: Prevents the organism from falling asleep.

name: Iron Barbs
description: Damages the attacker on contact.

name: Marvel Scale
description: Boosts Defense by 50% if the organism has a status condition.

name: Merciless
description: Attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

name: Moody
description: Raises one stat and lowers another at the end of every turn.

name: Multiscale
description: Reduces damage taken when HP is full.

name: Natural Cure
description: Cures status conditions upon switching out.

name: No Guard
description: Ensures that all moves used by or against the organism land.

name: Overcoat
description: Protects from weather damage and powder moves.

name: Parental Bond
description: Allows the organism to attack twice in one turn.

name: Poison Heal
description: Restores HP if the organism is poisoned instead of losing HP.

name: Prankster
description: Gives priority to status moves.

name: Reckless
description: Boosts the power of recoil moves.

name: Regenerator
description: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.

name: Swift Hunter
description: Passively boosts the organism's speed by 20%.

name: Cornered Beast
description: Attack is boosted by 50% when HP falls below 30%.

name: Drought
description: Summons harsh sunlight when entering battle.

name: Snow Warning
description: Summons snowstrom when entering battle.

name: Sand Stream
description: Summons sandstorm when entering battle.

name: Electric Surge
description: Creates Electric Terrain when entering battle.

name: Sand Rush
description: Speed doubles in sandstorm.

name: Chlorophyll
description: Speed doubles in harsh sunlight.

name: Swift Swim
description: Speed doubles in rain.

name: Slush Rush
description: Speed doubles in snow.

name: Cold-blooded
description: Speed Raises by 1 stage during sunny weather and drops by 1 stage during rain or snow weather while entering the field.

name: Camouflage Carapace
description: In Swamp biome, user gains Stealth on entry.

name: Reef Camouflage
description: In Coral Reef biome, user gains Stealth on entry.

name: Sticky Hold
description: Prevents the organism from being forced out of battle.

name: True Flight
description: Grants all offensive advantages of Flying type but ignores their disadvantages.

name: Abyss Dweller
description: Prevents moves that force a switch and grants immunity to Stun status.

name: Echolocation
description: Prevents accuracy from being lowered and ignores enemy stealth effects.

name: Harvest
description: May create a new Berry to replace one the organism has already used.

name: Unburden
description: Doubles the Speed stat if the organism's held item is used or lost.

name: Water Absorb
description: Restores HP when hit by an Aquatic-type move.

name: Volt Absorb
description: Restores HP when hit by an Electric-type move.

name: Flash Fire
description: Protects from Fire-type moves and boosts Attack when hit by one.

name: Lightning Rod
description: Protects from Electric-type moves and boosts Power when hit by one.

name: Sap Sipper
description: Protects from Grass-type moves and boosts Attack when hit by one.
